name: Palo Alto entitlement upgraded to 24x7 enterprise
description: Palo Alto entitlement upgraded to 24x7 enterprise

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM entitlement
WHERE entitlement_id = 73
  AND account_id = 8
  AND product_id = 140
  AND support_level = 'enterprise'
  AND coverage_hours = 'h24x7'
  AND active = 1;

name: KB is attached to the case
description: KB is attached to the case
